title: Senior Product Software Engineer (Clojurescript)
location_raw: SF Bay Area, Chicago, LA or Remote
description:
About Tyba
Tyba is a modeling platform for energy companies developing, financing, and operating renewable energy infrastructure. Energy companies rely on technical models daily to make crucial infrastructure decisions.
Our mission is to make cutting-edge models accessible to cross-functional teams so that companies can build and operate more renewable energy more profitably. We are backed by leading climate and generalist VCs and work with many of the industry’s most innovative energy companies.

The Role
We are looking for a Senior Product Software Engineer to join our Engineering team and lead key initiatives that deliver high-value, customer-facing products.
You will excel in this role if you thrive in fast-paced environments, have a strong sense of ownership, and are comfortable bringing clarity to ambiguous problems. You will drive major portions of the engineering roadmap—from concept to launch—working closely with product, policy, and commercial stakeholders.
This is a full-stack role involving both backend and frontend development, with an emphasis on building scalable systems and delivering high-quality, maintainable code.

Our Product
Tyba has two main products for customers – Asset Operations and Project Simulation
Asset Operations: An Auto-bidding platform, powered by a proprietary neural network, that recommends and executes operating strategies based on industry-leading price forecasts and optimization methodology.
Project Simulation: A configurable simulation platform enabling developers to model realistic financial and physical outcomes based on location, market dynamics, and battery specifications.
You’ll focus most of your time on Asset Operations while staying connected to Project Simulation. Within Asset Operations, you’ll lead key efforts to support new energy markets and strengthen our product in existing markets. You’ll focus on giving our customers more control over their batteries and articulating through the product why the battery chose to take a particular action.

Responsibilities

- Lead engineering initiatives end-to-end. This includes scoping, development (frontend and backend), testing, releasing, and monitoring.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Policy, and Marketing teams to ensure alignment and push the product forward.

- Demonstrate a high bar for code quality. Our customers deserve the best.

- Exceptional communication, half of Tyba is remote across different U.S. timezones

- Debug and fix production issues + participate in an on-call rotation.

Required Skills

- 5+ years of professional full-stack software engineering experience

- Strong proficiency in Clojurescript

- Proficiency in React

- Motivated to learn Python quickly (Python is our backend language)

- Ability to work cross-functionally, synthesizing requests from non-technical team members and external parties into well-designed engineering solutions

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements

- Basic proficiency with agentic coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, Warp Agent Mode): You should be able to leverage AI-assisted development to accelerate your workflow while maintaining a high bar for code quality. This means having the judgment to review machine-generated code critically, understanding where AI tools excel and where they can go astray, and knowing when to trust automation vs. when to write code yourself.

Preferred Skills

- Experience with Fulcro and Datomic

- Experience with Recharts, ECharts, or similar graphing libraries

- Experience with GraphQL

- Thought leadership in AI-assisted development : You’ve developed workflows, best practices, or tooling around agentic coding — perhaps contributing to prompt engineering, evaluating new tools, or helping teams adopt AI effectively while avoiding common pitfalls

- Passion for clean energy and the energy transition

Tyba’s Technical Stack
Tyba’s Asset Operations stack is developed in Python and runs on AWS. We rely on PyTorch for building our neural network architectures. Our backend services span Python, Clojure, and Kotlin, with a data layer built on PostgreSQL and Redshift.
Our frontend is built in ClojureScript. It uses the Fulcro library for managing client-server interactions and Tailwind CSS for styling. The frontend and backend communicate using a GraphQL API built using the Strawberry library.

Compensation and benefits

- Salary : $160k-$200k

- Benefits : Parental leave, medical benefits and unlimited PTO

- Equity Options: Opportunity to own a stake in the company through an employee stock option plan.

- Flexible Work Environment: Hybrid work model, remote work options, and team offsites.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
About Tyba
Tyba is a modeling platform for energy companies developing, financing, and operating renewable energy infrastructure. Energy companies rely on technical models daily to make crucial infrastructure decisions.
Our mission is to make cutting-edge models accessible to cross-functional teams so that companies can build and operate more renewable energy more profitably. We are backed by leading climate and generalist VCs and work with many of the industry’s most innovative energy companies.

The Role
We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Executive (AE) in Houston, TX to join our team. The ideal candidate has a history of exceeding sales quotas, loves selling highly technical products, and is capable of thriving in a dynamic, fast-paced work environment. They will also have experience with 6-12 month sales cycles with complex & regulated organizations, doing deep discovery, and selling to multiple decision makers, both technical and non-technical ones.
The position will play an integral role in helping build the foundation of Tyba’s growing commercial organization, as they build and own their territory, as we bring groundbreaking technology to an industry in dire need of new solutions.

Responsibilities

- Being a consultant to customers on Tyba’s platform and the energy landscape.

- Conduct discovery calls, presentations, and demos with a broad level of audiences including C-level stakeholders.

- Develop expansion opportunities from our existing customer base and land new target accounts.

- Provide timely and accurate forecasts with clear visibility on sales and revenue performance by actively handling your pipeline of opportunities.

- Leverage cross-functional internal teams (Engineering, Marketing, Product, Commercial Operations) to advance sales cycles.

- Track all opportunity and customer details including use case, purchase time frames, next steps, and forecasting in CRM.

- Work strategically with management to identify trending opportunities / challenges and provide recommended solutions.

- Build a pipeline with Marketing and within your network.

Skills & Experience

- 7+ years of experience in a closing role at a SaaS provider with a record of top performance.

- 3+ years of experience selling highly technical products to Enterprise ($5B+ revenue) organizations. Experience selling to utilities or energy companies is a plus.

- A desire to be a foundational piece in the company, acting as the customers voice internally

- Experience working with Director of Sales to perfect sales processes, materials

- Success building out territories, generating pipeline with Marketing teams, and breaking into new markets

- Experience selling $200k+ deals in regulated markets that involve customer in-person sales meetings and PoCs or trial periods.

- Early stage SaaS company experience and enthusiasm for building out a great sales team and culture with the team.

Compensation and benefits

- Salary : Expected total compensation package (base salary+ commission) ranging from $230k to $270k+, depending on experience and qualifications

- Benefits : Parental leave, medical benefits, and unlimited PTO

- Equity Options: Opportunity to own a stake in the company through an employee stock option plan.

- Flexible Work Environment: Hybrid work model, remote work options, and team offsites.

What is the interview process like?
Our interview process focuses on core competencies. We want to make sure that you are set up for success at a fast-growing and high-impact startup. We will first get to know each other through conversations about Tyba, your background, and what you are looking for in your next role. While the specifics vary, from there, we will focus on evaluating your skills and experience relevant to the role. Once we have determined whether or not you are a fit for the team, we will help you get to know the company better and speak with other team members to inform your decision. We prioritize transparency, clear communication, and ensuring that we do our best to find a mutual fit.

title: Consultant, Commercial Operations
description:
Note: We are still accepting and reviewing applications as of 9/22/2026!

About Tyba
Tyba is a modeling platform for energy companies developing, financing, and operating renewable energy infrastructure. Energy companies rely on technical models daily to make crucial infrastructure decisions and operate their assets.
Our mission is to make cutting-edge models accessible to cross-functional teams so that companies can build and operate more renewable energy more profitably. We are backed by leading climate and generalist VCs and work with many of the industry's most innovative energy companies.

The role
If you love working with customers and empowering them to solve complex business problems with data, this is the role for you.
We're looking for a Consultant to join our Commercial Operations team and drive our client engagement model. You will operate as a Tyba expert on battery storage and use that expertise to support our commercial objectives. You will onboard, support, and nurture customer relationships end-to-end, from product education to ongoing consulting and analytics services, while collaborating closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Policy, and Engineering teams. Your work will help ensure our products deliver tangible business outcomes for both prospective and current customers. The ideal candidate has experience in customer-facing roles, absorbs complex technical concepts quickly, and communicates them clearly to customers and executives, both in polished written materials and in live discussion. Experience in energy-related roles is helpful but not required.

Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end experience of our customers.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic customer accounts, including facilitating customer meetings, providing product education and support, triaging product requests, orchestrating customer-specific analyses, and owning key stakeholder relationships.

- Drive customer onboarding and technical implementation processes, including management of complex asset and market integrations.

- Conduct technical analyses working with both internal / external APIs and large timeseries datasets.

- Serve as a subject matter expert on company products and relevant power market, utility, and state programs that impact modeling.

- Develop and maintain internal BI tools to conduct analyses to support sales opportunities and customer engagements.

- Research relevant incentive programs and regulations to support Tyba's customers.

- Be the voice of the customer to the company on how we can better serve customers to maximize value and retention; as part of this, you will provide feedback to Product and Engineering teams to inform our product development.

- Support Tyba Sales and Marketing teams with business development through your battery storage expertise and domain knowledge.

Required Skills

- 3+ years of experience, ideally in consulting or customer-facing roles.

- Independent learner who ramps quickly on unfamiliar, technical domains and reasons soundly with limited guidance.

- Experience driving complex technical integrations end to end, ideally working closely with Engineering and other technical teams.

- Strong working knowledge of Excel and BI tools such as Tableau; familiarity with Python and API-based tools is a plus.

- Excellent verbal communication and presence: explains complex concepts clearly to any audience and stays composed under tough questions.

- Excellent written communication: produces polished customer- and executive-facing materials that lead with the "so what."

- Familiarity with energy markets, trading, or infrastructure financing is a plus.

Compensation and benefits

- Salary : $145K-$175K, depending on experience and qualifications.

- Benefits: Parental leave, medical benefits, and unlimited PTO.

- Equity Options: Opportunity to own a stake in the company through an employee stock option plan.

This role is in-person / hybrid at one of our Oakland (SF Bay Area) or Los Angeles offices.

What is the interview process like?
Our interview process focuses on core competencies. We want to make sure that you are set up for success at a fast-growing and high-impact startup. We will first get to know each other through conversations about Tyba, your background, and what you are looking for in your next role. While the specifics vary, from there, we will focus on evaluating your skills and experience relevant to the role. Once we have determined whether you are a fit for the team, we will help you get to know the company better and speak with other team members to inform your decision. We prioritize transparency, clear communication, and ensuring that we do our best to find a mutual fit.

title: People Operations Manager
description:
About Tyba
Tyba is a modeling platform for energy companies developing, financing, and operating renewable energy infrastructure. Energy companies rely on technical models daily to make crucial infrastructure decisions and operate their assets.
Our mission is to make cutting-edge models accessible to cross-functional teams so that companies can build and operate more renewable energy more profitably. We are backed by leading climate and generalist VCs and work with many of the industry's most innovative energy companies.
The role
We're looking for a People Operations Manager to own our HR operations function, and help us build the transformational people programs that will take our team development to the next level.
Day to day, we need a process-focused operations leader to own the essentials: people compliance, payroll and benefits, hiring logistics, onboarding, and our office. You’ll also play a critical role in shaping the next phase of people development, leading strategic initiatives to evolve our performance development program, onboarding program, and professional development. The person in this role will help us to design and build our people operations function from the ground up, not just inherit someone else's template.
To do that well, we want you to truly understand Tyba’s business and be a strategic partner to its leaders. If you’re mission-driven and believe in the future that Tyba is building — this role is for you. More than anything, we're looking for someone who is mid-career with grit, good judgment, and a real caring for people, who's excited to clean up processes, develop new ideas, and help us scale our business. We’re also ready and able to invest in that person’s growth, dedicating budget to learning, growth, new tools, and resources to improve how we do things.
If that sounds like you, there's a lot of room to grow this into a leadership role as we scale.
Responsibilities

- Take care of people compliance, including filings, policies, and staying current on employment law across our footprint

- Manage payroll and benefits, including vendor relationships and being a helpful, responsive resource when people have questions or run into issues

- Tackle first iterations of a few learning and development projects for the org, helping people find growth paths and that make the Tyba experience special, possible projects within:

- Build our performance process, from setting goals to running thoughtful review cycles

- Design and build our onboarding program, including curriculum that helps new hires understand and connect with our business

- Support hiring logistics alongside our hiring managers and external recruiters, from scheduling to offers to background checks

- Keep our HQ office running well, including vendors, supplies, and the everyday details that make coming into work pleasant

- Look at our existing people processes with fresh eyes, and fix what isn't serving the team well anymore

Skills and experience:

- 5+ years of experience in HR operations, ideally at high-growth startups

- A track record of building new processes from scratch, not just running what already exists

- Working knowledge of payroll, benefits, and employment compliance

- Someone happy to handle the details personally while also thinking ahead to what we'll need next

- Curiosity about our business, and a willingness to learn what makes it tick

- Based in the San Francisco Bay Area and willing to be in Oakland office for 3-4 days per week minimum

- Bonus: Experience designing or running learning and development programs, curriculum, or professional growth frameworks

Compensation and benefits:

- Salary : $160-190K, depending on experience and qualifications.

- Benefits: Parental leave, medical benefits, and unlimited PTO.

- Equity Options: Opportunity to own a stake in the company through an employee stock option plan.
